title: CapacityTable
description: capacity.json (Replicas and HPA): what each traffic level would take of the workload under test, from the per-replica SLO-max RPS and the per-replica sizing. Always written; rows is empty, with a reason, when the run has no SLO-max. capacity.csv holds the same rows.

rps_per_replica.description: SLO-max RPS of one replica (analysis.json capacity.per_replica).

replica_headroom.description: h_rep: each replica is planned at rps_per_replica × (1 − h_rep).

per_replica.description: The recommended requests of one replica: the sum over the workload's containers.

is_scale_out_verified.description: True only when runs at two or more replica counts showed per-replica RPS within 10%; otherwise linear scale-out is assumed.

infra_cost.description: What a replica costs, which the rows' cost_per_hour multiplies (capacity_model.json infra_cost).

token_cost.description: Token cost per request at the SLO-max stage (capacity_model.json token_cost).

cost_per_hour.description: Infrastructure cost when pricing is set.

is_target_rps.description: The row of analysis.target_rps; its replicas are what the patches use.
